entities.summary: Rod Frawley is a former tennis player from Australia, who won one singles title and five doubles titles during his professional career. The right-hander reached his highest ATP singles ranking of world No. 43 in December 1980. His highest ranking in doubles, world No. 23, was achieved in March 1980.
